REPORT
Date February 13, 1940.

Subject F.R. Leekney.

Made by D.J.I. Prokofiev.    Forwarded by.

（批：Copy sent to 'D'）

On April 25, 1939, in connection with communication dated 13-4-39 from the Netherlands Consulate-General requesting information regarding one Mr. F.R. Leekney, Latvian, applicant for a visa for admission into the Netherlands East Indies, the following report was submitted concerning this individual:-

"Friedrichs Alfreds LEEKNEY is reported to have been residing in Shanghai for many years, during which period he worked here as a portrait, landscape and architectural artist.

He is well spoken of by certain responsible members of the local Latvian community and also is favourably known in the German community.

His material circumstances, however, do not appear to be very bright, partly on account of general depression in his line of business and partly, perhaps, because of his alleged inability of getting along with members of the public.

For the past two years or so he has been residing at 142 Museum Road ( Capitol Building ), where he occupies one roomed flat ( No. 4 ).

While in Shanghai he did not come to the notice of the Municipal Police in connection with any activities of an undesirable nature, with the exception of a case which occurred in September, 1937, when he was warned to discontinue his practice of appearing on the roof of the Capitol Building during air-raids and whilst shelling was taking place. In this connection Mr. Leekney stated that the reason why he used to go on the

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY No. S. B. D. Date April 25, 39）
Subject. Communication dated 13-4-39 from the Netherlands Consulate-General
concerning F.A. Leekney.
Made by D.S. 1. Prokofiev Forwarded by C. Canova (?)

Friedrichs Alfreds LEEKNEY is reported to
have been residing in Shanghai for many years, during
which period he worked here as a portrait, landscape and
architectural artist.

He is well spoken of by certain responsible
members of the local Latvian community and is also fa-
vourably known in the German community.

His material circumstances, however, do not
appear to be very bright, partly on account of general
depression in his line of business and partly, perhaps, be-
cause of his alleged inability of getting along with mem-
bers of the public.

For the past two years or so he has been re-
siding at 142 Museum Road, where he occupies one-roomed
flat ( No 4 ).

While in Shanghai he did not come to the no-
tice of the Municipal Police in connection with any acti-
vities of an undesirable nature, with the exception of a
case which occurred in September, 1937, when he was warned
to discontinue his practice of appearing on the roof of
the Capitol Building during air-raids and whilst shelling
was taking place. In this connection Mr. Leekney stated
that the reason why he used to go on the roof of the
building in question was to obtain a good view of the hos-
tilities , as he wished to make a picture of same.

A. Prokopiev
D. S. 1.

（批：P.A. to D.C. (Sp. Br.) 25/4）

D. C. ( Special Branch ).

事由：荷兰总领事馆1939年4月13日关于F.A. Leekney的来函。
制作人：D.S. 1. Prokofiev 转呈人：C. Canova (?)

据报，Friedrichs Alfreds LEEKNEY已在上海居住多年，在此期间，他在此从事肖像、风景及建筑艺术家的工作。

当地拉脱维亚社群中某些负责成员对他评价良好，他在德国社群中也享有良好的声誉。

然而，他的经济状况似乎并不十分乐观，部分原因是其行业普遍不景气，部分原因或许是因为据称他不善于与公众相处。

在过去两年左右的时间里，他一直居住在博物馆路142号，占用一套一居室公寓（4号）。

在上海期间，除1937年9月发生的一起事件外，他并未因任何不良性质的活动引起工部局警务处的注意。在该事件中，他被警告停止在空袭和炮击期间出现在首都大厦屋顶的行为。就此，Leekney先生表示，他之所以常去该建筑物的屋顶，是为了获得观察战事的良好视野，因为他希望为此作画。

A. Prokopiev
D. S. 1.

（批：呈副总监（特务科） 4月25日）

副总监（特务科）。

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

SHANGHAI,

No. 1128.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. R. D. 9126
Date 15 4 39

15th April 1939

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Friedriche Alfreds
LIMKEY has applied to this Consulate General for a visé for
admission into the Netherlands Indies

The applicant who was born at Riga on March 12, 1880, is
a painter by profession and in possession of a Latvian pass-
port No. 008927E issued at the Latvian Consulate at Harbin on
May 15th 1935, valid until 1940.

He intends to leave for Singapore in the course of next
month and the possibility exists that he wishes to visit the
Netherlands Indies.

His residence is situated at 142 Museum Road, Apartment 4.

I should be greatly obliged to you if you would let me
know if possible, whether anything is known against this person
from a political or moral point of view.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔签名〕
Consul.

51/
yR

The Deputy Commissioner
Special Branch, Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

D. S. J. Probyn

特务科登记处
编号 S. R. D. 9126
日期 1939年4月15日

1939年4月15日

先生，

谨此告知，Friedriche Alfreds LIMKEY已向本总领事馆申请进入荷属东印度群岛的签证。

申请人于1880年3月12日出生于里加，职业为画家，持有1935年5月15日由拉脱维亚驻哈尔滨领事馆签发的第008927E号拉脱维亚护照，有效期至1940年。

他打算在下个月内前往新加坡，且有可能希望访问荷属东印度群岛。

其住所位于博物馆路142号4室。

如蒙告知从政治或道德角度是否知晓此人有任何不良记录，本人将不胜感激。

谨此致意，
先生，
您忠实的仆人，

〔签名〕
领事。

51/
yR

副总监
特务科，上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

D. S. J. Probyn
